note: SCANGATE trust anchor. This is the one place trust is granted rather than derived: a scanner cannot scan itself without infinite regress. Re-verify the pin on each version bump and have the incumbent image scan a candidate before promotion (N-1 scans N).
review_focus: the source diff between pinned and candidate
any change that WEAKENS detection — a silently deleted YARA signature or relaxed pattern is the highest-value way to attack a scanner, because it leaves no trace in the scanner's own output
